name: characteristic spatial frequency
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 不平顺周期分量对应的特征空间频率。
usage_note: 文中与周期轨道结构联系；不能误写为时间频率。

complete_examples.text: St(f) is the trend part of the track spectrum, which is a fifth-order polynomial with regard to the spatial frequency f in a log–log coordinate system and does not include the periodic components; a5 , a4 , a3 , a2 , a1, and a0 are the shape parameters to control the PSD function St(f) ; Q is the total count of noticeable and essential local peaks observed in the track spectrum S(f) ; fc, i is the ith characteristic spatial frequency, at which the local peak occurs, representing the periodic component; gi symbolizes a scale parameter, serving as a determinant for the extent of concentration of the PSD in the proximity of the frequency fc, i; Rc, i acts as an amplitude parameter, governing the magnitude of the local peak within the PSD curve at the frequency fc, i . When f is equal to fc, i , an amplification factor (1 + Rc, i) will appear at fc, i . The unit of St(f) and S(f) is mm2/m−1 , and the unit of f is m−1 .
Only one characteristic spatial frequency is considered for easy observation.
